notes.title: UPDATE v1.0.8
notes.notes:
Wishing everyone a prosperous and happy new year! 

New Content:
- The original soundtrack (OST) of "Path of Purification" is now available!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43010601/857bd7454be942e5c24d12ef6454b34960ac4b06.jpg[/img]

Modified contents:
- [Sound Effects]: Optimized the sound effects in battles, optimized the background music in Endless Mode.
- [Physics]: Modified the physics collision in some levels.
- [Localization]: Adjusted the text display in Japanese.
- [Bug Fixes]: Fixed some bugs that affected the gaming experience.

notes.title: Update log version 1.0.7
notes.notes:
Based on the feedback from our players, we have made the following adjustments:

Modified contents:

[Physics]: Improved the physical collision of obstacles within levels.
[Physics]: Optimized the collision detection accuracy of bombs.
[Balancing]: Optimized the behavior logic of some enemies in "West Wild".
[Balancing]: Reduced the spawn rate of small maps in the “Sing all night”.
[UI]: Fine-tuned the display effects and fixed display bugs.

notes.title: Update log version 1.0.6
notes.notes:
Based on the feedback from our players, we have made the following adjustments:

Modified contents:
- [Sound]: Optimized the playback of sound effects, making it no longer harsh to play a large number of sound effects at the same time.
- [Map]: Sing all night and Street maps have fixed the detection of physical collisions.
- [Balance]: Flying objects fired by the Dealer Girl and Tea Lady can no longer pass through obstacles.
- [Balance]: The prepare time for the close-range slash attack of the final boss in the Street stage has been increased, and the summoned characters have been corrected to the characters that appear in the Street stage.

notes.title: Update log version 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Based on the feedback from our players, we have made the following adjustments:

Modified contents:
- [System]: In the skill arrangement stage, you can continue the game as long as you reach the upper limit of retained skills, and skills will no longer be forced to be destroyed.
- [Sound Effect]: Andras Fever sound effect is no longer harsh.
- [Map]: Modify the collision range of some ice and snow maps.
- [Balance]: Reduce the flying speed of the watermelon knife at the West Wild level.

notes.title: Update log of version 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Based on the feedback from our players, we have made the following adjustments:

[System]: Added 4 new quests to each Demon Ritua, reduced the difficulty of completing some tasks, making the acquisition of experience points more efficient!
[System]: After each battle, the Demon Ritua will be awarded experience points based on the number of collected aura rings.

notes.title: Update log of version 1.0.0
notes.notes:
New content:
-[Map]: Chapter 4- West Wild, New Enemies, New Arch angel in West Wild!
-[System]: The growth system has been remade, and character growth only occurs during battles.
-[System]: Add sprint action.
-[Challenge]: Endless Mode!
-[System]: Add "Demon Ritua", in which skills, characters, and character attribute bonuses can be unlocked.
-[Hardware]: Supports Steam Deck.
-[System]: Support Steam Cloud!
-[System]: Support Steam achievements!

Update:
-[UI]: Significantly adjusted the game UI interface and added visual feedback.
-[Performance]: The animation of boss come on stage can be skipped by pressing ESC (button B).
-[Bug]: Modify bugs that affect the gaming experience.

To old friends:
-There have been many changes in the version 1.0, and the savedata files are not compatible with Early Access version.
-The content unlocked in Early Access may need to be unlocked again in the official version, please be aware.

Finally, thank you to every player who participated in the Early Access version. Version 1.0 has finally been launched!

notes.title: "Path to purge" Official Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Congratulations! Congratulations! 
The release date of "Path to purge" version 1.0 is scheduled for January 16, 2024. Thank you who have been supporting us until today! Whether you are a new player or an old one who has purchased the EA version, e-sheep studio hope that you can share our happiness and experience the fun of the game in "Path to purge" version 1.0. The version 1.0 released this time will replace the EA version, and the archives of the EA version will be overwritten and cannot be restored. Players who have purchased it are advised to pay attention. As for the many new contents added in version 1.0, you are invited to explore and discover them on your own !

notes.title: New Major Update is Coming!
notes.notes:
Thanks for waiting! We E-Sheep finished our new version development. Woohooo!
This update will be a combination of 0.1 and 0.2. It contains 1 new area, 9 new monsters, 1 new boss and 2 brand new playable characters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43010601/ad392b1aec0613024f3ba13253eb25e3f2e4215f.png[/img]


[h1]New Maps[/h1]

[h3]Winter is Coming[/h3]
"An icy, snowy and inaccessible village. How can Angelos choose here as their base?"

New map "Ice World" update.

Ice World area mainly is ice lakes and snow mountain. Why was this place polluted by Angelos? How can the Goetias fighting with monsters and Angelos in this tortuous place?

[h1]New Monsters[/h1]

Let's see those who welcome us to this icy mountain. They are dangerous, identical and aggressive. 


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43010601/726a0df740cccd3faf9c97274a7c6846ebe0cddb.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43010601/c12e07ef4e0bc2a18cb9475046107a4521bc3376.png[/img][/url]
[h3]The Lantern[/h3]
Hunter who lives in inner of the mountain. Be careful, he will throw his axe if he finds any prey no matter if it's human or not.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43010601/324e715e5b6e714141345740585b3edf557cdc99.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43010601/220cb4ebf471e83de278a032e3f6c55999ceb2d7.png[/img][/url][h3]Cool Down[/h3]
He wears in very thick clothes which makes he feel hot. So he wants everybody else to cool down. His dryer has a strong power which can push others back.


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43010601/95ed9494eb1976b0e8c6b7f0127dca73d727fe64.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43010601/3e999b1f224183b73cc3f8c2117f45930e39eb5e.png[/img][/url][h3]Fire Candle[/h3]
He burning himself for keep warm. A very nice guy that worries others may be too cold to die. However, he is too zealous to let others feel his "warm-heart".


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43010601/12c79ce8c21bdeac6475128132cd11682ec50f4b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43010601/c405eb3d53d698c014f418a111fc53bc4f5c794b.png[/img][/url]
[h3]Spring Lady[/h3]
A rich snow woman who lives in the mountain. She loves hot springs but can never get in since she may melt. Usually we can see her walking her dog...sorry, her ghost and fire in the mountains.


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43010601/0789d333d809cdd3f0ded7d8ae757a895cbdcee3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43010601/c6149c3fec9f881f8b50ad8cf7d59b73af07e9e7.png[/img][/url]
[h3]Ice Lover[/h3]
She loves ice cream as her life. If she sees anyone who doesn't have ice cream, she will take that person as enemy and give you a shock (phisical).


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43010601/1686c62f1eab2fe9291d07549409259d82fac401.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43010601/4cd1fd927d7f7172b3f65dd63cc29cd14110a3b7.png[/img][/url]
[h3]Weather Alert[/h3]
The observer who studies on weather. She has a weird chemical reagent with her coat. Nobody knows what it is for. Sometimes the reagent will leak out and produce frozen mist which can freeze people to death.


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43010601/c1fabec7917e98d9a441512822603782ccca2eeb.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43010601/aeb7e7753fae818aa9e892f2aaeb193995be0137.png[/img][/url]
[h3]Merry Xmax[/h3]
A bandaged man with a snowman's head and a big iron ball. Maybe the mountain is too cold for him. He likes to use the iron ball to drive himself in circles from time to time.


[h1]New Characters[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43010601/a6071af1df17f9d8f5160c5613afa2db01899714.png[/img][h3]Crocell[/h3]
49th Goetia from Mother Lilith. She is hard-working and effective. Crocell uses twin-pistols as her weapon. She likes attacking while moving around.




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43010601/f95cae26afa47fb7ae42a87a3b0b886103a99b7a.png[/img][h3]Vassago[/h3]
3rd Goetia from Mother Lilith. She is gentle and she loves cleaning. Vassago calls her purging "cleaning" and her weapon, a sniper, broom.

notes.title: Ver0.06 Update
notes.notes:
Ver0.06
IMPOTANT!
Since we made a great change to the growth system, we highly recommend users who update from v0.04 choose "Start New Game" to avoid any possible errors. For users updating from v0.05 can choose "Continue" to play but need reset weapon ranks.
Fixes:
- [Stats] Enemies stats during Stages growth smoother.
- [Stats] Exp required for Levelup decrease.
- [System] Readjust weapon damage, reload speed and weapon skills for Andras and Amdusias
- [System] Temporarily removed Elite enemies' weapon skill drop off system, the system will be back after proper adjustion.
- [Bug] fixes serveral bugs.

notes.title: BIG BANG! Version0.05 major update coming!
notes.notes:
WARNING
Since this is a big update, we highly recommend our current users START NEW GAME 
to enjoy our fresh new skills, abilities, systems and battle experience.

New Features:
- [Weapon] Weapon Ability system replaced Weapon Upgrade system.
- [Weapon] Weapon specified skills can be drop off when elite enemy defeated.
- [Skills] Added 31 skills in skill pool(9 bomb type, 8 ice type, 7 poison type and 7 thunder type), fixed some applied skills, current skill pool has 44 skills.
- [Language] Japanese supported.

Fixes
- [UI] improved SoulStone layout.
- [UI] improved WeaponRankUp layout.
- [UI] Optimized keyboard operation.
- [Perfomance] Optimized picture resources and improved game running efficiency.
- [Perfomance] Optimized skill effects and improved game running efficiency.
- [Stats] Numerical growth of enemies in the level will be smoother.
- [Stats] Tuned numerical strength of SoulStone interface and PrayStone interface.
- [Stats] Weapon growth no longer increases player's HP, and the enemies' attack is also greatly reduced.
- [Gameplay] Modified Box drop method.
- [Gameplay] Modified skill drop off method, drop skill will be dynamically adjusted by player's choice.
- [Gameplay] Modify the NPC function, NPCs will no longer be asking for skill only but not give any back.
- [Gameplay] Maps fusion in two big Area: SingAllNight and Commercial Street. Each Area has 30 stages.

P.S. Since this is a heavy update, we may not able to add new Area, stages and characters. However,
we have made many new attempts on gameplay, if there's any unreasonable or mistake during your gameplay,
please feel free to contact us and we'll improve as soon as possible. Thanks for your supports. We are also
making new contents, including new stages and characters, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Version Preview:The test version 0.05 will be updated on December 5th.
notes.notes:
Version Preview:
The test version 0.05 will be updated on December 5th.
After one month's practice, we have collected many valuable suggestions, in the meantime, we haven't stopped working, and new skills are about to be introduced.
The following updates will be carried out on December 5th and December 22nd, these updates are still in testing period. If you find any problems, please feel free to contact us.Thank you so much for your support.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43010601/c8833705e102ca14c90990a53471825b3ffe63ff.jpg[/img]
======================

Version V005
Important Note:
Since the Growth System has changed a lot, please choose "New Game" after updating to the new version, and then to enjoy new skills, new systems and new balanced combat experience.

New Additions:
-[Weapon] A new weapon entry system was added, and the original upgrade system of weapons was removed.
-[Skills] 31 skills (9 explosion, 8 ice, 7 poison, 7 lightning) were added, a few of old skills were modified or removed, and the total number of skills reaches 44.
Modifications:
-[UI] Improved the Soul Stone interface 
-[UI] Improved the Weapon Upgrade interface 
-[UI] Optimized the keyboard operation
-[Performance] Optimized the image resources and promoted the operation efficiency of the game.
-[Performance] Optimized the special effects of skills, and promoted the operation efficiency of the game.
-[Figure] The enemy figure growth will be smoother within a level.
-[Figure] The entry of Soul Stone interface has adjusted slightly, and the figure of prayer of Lilith's interface has strengthed.
-[Figure] Weapon growth will no longer increase the leading role's physical strength, and the enemy attack has also been significantly.
-[Play] Modified the drop rules of express boxes.
-[Play] Modified the skill drop method, the drop probability of skills would be dynamically adjusted according to the player's choice.
-[Play] Modified the NPC function of the story level, and cancelled the mechanism that NPC only asks, not gives.
